title: Marketplace "scan to receive" QR vs. ordinary buyer payment
summary: The recipient is selling a used item on BechoBazaar. A buyer calls, agrees the price, and offers to pay by UPI. In the fraud case, the buyer sends a QR code and tells the seller to scan it and enter their UPI PIN to "receive" the money; scanning it actually sends money. In the legitimate case, the buyer asks for the seller's UPI ID or phone number and sends the payment, and the seller only has to check the credit.

shared_setting.recipient_profile: the seller; profile sampled at generation.
other_facts: Item: a used household item (for example a study table or a cycle), price [AMOUNT_7] (₹2,500–₹12,000).
Both buyers are polite, agree the listed price quickly, and say they will pay in advance before pickup.

fraud.label_rationale: The buyer instructs the seller to scan a QR code and enter their UPI PIN in order to receive money. Entering a UPI PIN authorises a payment from the seller's account.
fraud.caller_objective: Make the seller pay [AMOUNT_7] via the QR code.
stable_facts: The buyer sends a QR image in chat during the call.
The buyer says "scan this, enter your PIN, and the money will come to you".
The buyer claims to be busy and unable to come before paying.

caller_continuation_limits: The fraud buyer may resend the QR, claim a technical problem, or send a second QR "for the refund". A second QR of the same kind is the same mechanism and allowed. They must not switch to OTP or link requests. The legitimate buyer must not send any QR or ask the seller for any PIN.

must_preserve: UPI ID request and outgoing payment in _L
may_vary: buyer's excuse for paying in advance

ambiguities: Advance payment by a buyer is not evidence of fraud; both buyers offer it.
A legitimate buyer who pays by scanning the seller's QR is also legitimate, but that variant is not used here to keep the contrast clean.
If the fraud buyer only sends a QR without the PIN instruction, the prefix is not eligible for the branch-invariance experiment.

evidence_references.claim: UPI PIN is never needed to receive money; QR scanning is only for paying (C08)
